title: La Nuez de Parras, MEXI STORIES
comment: nuez-parras (MEXI): nogalera familiar en Parras de la Fuente, Coahuila. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.ANACLETO_DAVILA: Mexican man from Coahuila, pecan grower, 74 years old, thin, sun-weathered light-brown skin, white hair, white stubble, a beige straw hat, a faded denim work shirt, a brown leather belt, khaki trousers, worn boots, his hands empty.
chars.REFUGIO_DAVILA: Mexican woman from Coahuila, 68 years old, plump, light-brown skin, short grey permed hair, small glasses on a chain, a blue cardigan over a floral print dress, flat shoes, her hands empty.
chars.ULISES_GARZA: Mexican man, 35 years old, tall and strong, light-brown skin, shaved head, a short black beard, mirrored sunglasses on his head, an olive-green bomber jacket over a tight grey t-shirt, dark jeans, black boots, his hands empty.
chars.MATEO_DAVILA: Mexican businessman, 40 years old, light-brown skin, short black hair with grey temples, clean-shaven, a charcoal-grey suit with an open white shirt, a silver watch, black shoes, holding dark sunglasses.

locs.LOC_NOGALERA: Pecan orchard in Parras de la Fuente, Coahuila, during the autumn harvest in the late afternoon: rows of tall pecan trees with yellowing leaves, burlap sacks full of pecans on the ground, an old adobe farmhouse, a dirt road, dry desert mountains behind, golden light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
